title: Redbrand Hideout · Area 8 · Crevasse

sourceRecords.title: 14 · Crevasse and nothic · area 8
read: The worked stone gives way to a raw split in the earth. Two narrow bridges cross the dark gap, and the space below is difficult to make out.

The break in the cavern floor divides your approach into separate stretches of ground. Its edges and any visible crossing deserve a careful look before someone moves ahead. You can stop to judge the drop or keep to the near side while deciding what you want to investigate.

brief: Large natural cavern with twenty-foot-high ceiling, two rough stone support columns and a five-to-ten-foot-wide steep crevasse twenty feet deep. TWO modest arched plank bridges cross it, WITHOUT handrails. Separate bridges at north and south along the fissure. Rough southern access tunnel and worked northern storage end only where visible. No visible nothic, corpse or hidden chest, no glowing fissure, no conspicuous weakened planks. These are the initial observable features.
